source: Base input/output rates verified against official provider pricing pages on 2026-10-15 (OpenAI developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, Google ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, Anthropic platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and Anthropic List Prices 2026-10-07, xAI docs.x.ai/developers/pricing).
